fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Which features require a full threat review?
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Changing button color 2. Exporting order history to a file 3. Referral program with bonuses 4. Category filter 5. Support chat 6. Store rating display
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: full review — 2 (personal data export), 3 (money plus abuse potential), 5 (communication, personal data in chat). Do not require — 1, 4, 6. Takeaway: six triage criteria filter out the majority, and that's precisely why the process works.
